comparison.objective: Insert five flat coins through a piggy-bank slot.
comparison.physical_skill: Tabletop edge pinch, reorientation and narrow-slot insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Each coin wholly inside; bank not tipped or removed; all five held inside for 1 s. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Repeated single-object insertion is different from simultaneously passing one population while retaining another.
